candidates.snippet: 1162: Birth of Temüjin - Born Temüjin, who would later become Genghis Khan, on the Mongolian plateau. 1206: Unification of Mongol Tribes - Temüjin unified the nomadic tribes of the Mongolian plateau, laying the foundation for his empire. 1209: Invasion of the Western Xia Dynasty - Genghis Khan launched a campaign against the Tangut-led Western Xia Dynasty. 1211: Invasion of the Jin Dynasty - Genghis Khan initiated the Mongol invasion of the Jurchen-led Jin Dynasty in Northern China.
